rows.description: `timeseries-forecasting` repo contains a notebook or script that loads either TimesFM or Moirai as a zero-shot/fine-tuned baseline and reports its metrics alongside classical models
A public Weights & Biases project URL is linked in `timeseries-forecasting/README.md` and the linked workspace shows ≥1 completed run with logged loss curves
rows.verifyMethod: Open URL from README; confirm runs are publicly visible without login and contain training metrics

rows.description: `timeseries-forecasting` contains a `app.py` or `dashboard.py` Streamlit file that accepts a dataset/model selection and renders an interactive forecast plot
rows.verifyMethod: `cd timeseries-forecasting && streamlit run app.py` launches without error and displays forecast chart in browser

rows.description: A walk-forward validation diagram (image file) and a results table (markdown or CSV) exist in `timeseries-forecasting/` showing per-fold metrics across ≥3 models
rows.verifyMethod: `ls timeseries-forecasting/assets/ | grep -i "walk_forward|rolling"` and `ls timeseries-forecasting/ | grep -i "results"` both return files

rows.description: Monte Carlo Dropout is implemented in at least one model in `timeseries-forecasting`, producing prediction intervals (upper/lower bounds) visible in output or plots
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -r "mc_dropout|monte_carlo|enable_dropout" timeseries-forecasting/ --include="*.py" --include="*.ipynb"` returns ≥1 match; output contains confidence interval columns

rows.description: `mlops-serving/README.md` contains ≥2 embedded Grafana screenshot images showing live metrics panels (latency, throughput, or error rate)
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -i "grafana" mlops-serving/README.md` returns ≥2 image references; image files exist at referenced paths

rows.description: `mlops-serving/` contains an architecture diagram file (PNG/SVG) referenced in README depicting request flow from client through model server to monitoring stack
rows.verifyMethod: `ls mlops-serving/assets/ | grep -i "arch|diagram"` returns a file; README contains an `![` image tag pointing to it

rows.description: `mlops-serving/docker-compose.yml` exists and `docker compose up` brings up the full serving stack (model server + monitoring) with a single command, no manual configuration required
rows.verifyMethod: `cd mlops-serving && docker compose up --wait` exits 0 and `curl localhost:<port>/health` returns HTTP 200 within 60 s

rows.description: `mlops-serving/` contains an A/B test results notebook or script that computes statistical significance (p-value or confidence interval) between two model variants and displays a visualization
Evidently AI drift detection is integrated in `mlops-serving/` with a report or dashboard showing data/model drift for at least one feature set
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -r "evidently" mlops-serving/ --include="*.py" --include="*.ipynb" --include="requirements*.txt"` returns ≥1 match; a generated HTML or JSON report file exists

rows.description: `mlops-serving/` contains a vLLM or Ollama serving module/config (e.g., `llm_server.py`, `ollama-compose.yml`) with README section describing LLM serving usage
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -r "vllm|ollama" mlops-serving/ --include="*.py" --include="*.yml" --include="*.md"` returns ≥1 match in both a code/config file and README

rows.description: `deep-learning-cv` training data references a non-CIFAR-10 real-world dataset (e.g., iNaturalist, Food-101, or similar) with no remaining CIFAR-10 data loading code in active scripts
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -r "cifar" deep-learning-cv/ --include="*.py" --include="*.ipynb"` returns 0 matches in non-archived files

rows.description: `deep-learning-cv/` contains a CLIP zero-shot evaluation script/notebook listed as "Model 4" in the comparison table, with accuracy reported on the same test split as other three models
rows.verifyMethod: Results table in README shows ≥4 model rows including a CLIP row; `grep -i "clip" deep-learning-cv/ -r --include="*.py" --include="*.ipynb"` returns ≥1 match

rows.description: A Grad-CAM visualization gallery (≥6 images across ≥2 classes) is present in `deep-learning-cv/assets/` or a linked notebook with cells showing Grad-CAM overlays on real-world dataset images
rows.verifyMethod: `ls deep-learning-cv/assets/ | grep -i "gradcam|grad_cam"` returns ≥6 files, or notebook contains ≥6 rendered Grad-CAM output cells

rows.description: A live Gradio demo for `deep-learning-cv` is deployed (HuggingFace Spaces or equivalent) with its public URL in README, accepting image upload and returning top-3 predicted classes
rows.verifyMethod: Open URL from README; upload a test image; confirm prediction response renders within 30 s without error

rows.description: `timeseries-forecasting` and `mlops-serving` READMEs each contain a section explicitly positioning the project as a bridge to LLM/AI Engineer work (e.g., foundation models, LLM serving)
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -i "llm|foundation model|ai engineer" timeseries-forecasting/README.md mlops-serving/README.md` returns ≥1 match per file
